cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: HYPE value totalHypeValueReturned recorded in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount when a user cancels a withdrawal request
cancelled_withdrawal_amount.checkpoint: before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads and resets it

manager_role_held.meaning: the caller of redelegateWithdrawnHYPE holds MANAGER_ROLE privileges

redelegated_amount.meaning: HYPE amount actually re-delegated through _distributeStake with OperationType.SpotDeposit after truncating conversion

stranded_hype_amount.meaning: HYPE stranded in StakingManager outside totalStaked and hypeBuffer, reducing capital efficiency and potential profits for kHYPE holders

assumptions: The cancelled withdrawal amount is positive so that a remainder below 1e10 wei HYPE can exist.
The re-delegation path is reached after cancelWithdrawal records the amount and before any other reset of _cancelledWithdrawalAmount.

unresolved.description: The selected impact khype_profit_reduction is a potential reduction in protocol capital efficiency and profits for kHYPE holders; the report gives no numeric profit or capital-efficiency quantity, so the conservation relation is bound to the stranded HYPE amount rather than to a quantified profit reduction.
Report does not state whether the remainder loss occurs on every call or only when _cancelledWithdrawalAmount is not a multiple of 1e10.

limitations: The conservation pattern compares the recorded cancelled amount before re-delegation with the amount actually re-delegated; the report's remainder loss is the difference between them.
The profit-reduction impact is represented through the stranded HYPE amount because no numeric profit quantity is reported.
The scenario is conditional on a cancel-then-redelegate sequence; the report does not establish a concrete prior transaction amount.
